scope: Eight multiselect duplicate-default/count-error/recovery runs on one native WS; error representations are runtime-specific, no browser/UI claim.

json.body: {"case": "Default over", "phase": "load", "accepted": false, "error_type": "StreamlitSelectionCountExceedsMaxError", "error": "Multiselect has 2 options selected but `max_selections` is set to 1. This happened because you either gave too many options to `default` or you manipulated the widget's state through `st.session_state`. Note that the latter can happen before the line indicated in the traceback. Please select at most 1 option."}

{"case": "Zero", "phase": "load", "accepted": false, "error_type": "StreamlitValueError", "error": "Invalid `max_selections` value. Supported values: a positive integer. To disable `st.multiselect`, use `disabled=True`."}

{"case": "Outside", "phase": "load", "accepted": false, "error_type": "StreamlitDefaultNotInOptionsError", "error": "The default value '4' is not part of the options. Please make sure that every default value also exists in the options."}
